plans.name: Base Plan
features: Single node — Starting at $5/month for development and low-traffic workloads
Metal — Starting at $50/month with local NVMe storage for high-performance needs
High Availability — 1 primary + 2 replicas across 3 availability zones
Compute — Database instances, Neki routers, and Vitess VTGates
Topology — The number of shards and replicas
Storage — Storage capacity and, where configurable, provisioned IOPS and throughput. Storage is included for Metal databases.
Usage — Backup storage and network egress
Add-ons — Additional development branch hours, SSO, upgraded support
